SELECT 
  a.assessment_type,
  ROUND(
    SUM(CASE WHEN sa.date_submitted > a.date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(sa.id_student), 
    1
  ) AS late_submission_rate
FROM assessments a
JOIN studentAssessment sa ON a.id_assessment = sa.id_assessment
WHERE a.date IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY a.assessment_type;
